title: Shrub Jackets 2-Pack 120 × 180 cm – Shields from Wind and Cold
seo_title: Shrub Jacket 2-Pack 120 × 180 cm – Shields from Cold
seo_description: Shrub jacket 2-pack in beige nonwoven fabric, 120 × 180 cm per jacket. Zipper for watering and drawstring at the bottom edge. Fits shrubs and potted plants.
descriptionHtml:
The frost already on its way to the shrub

The first cold night comes earlier than expected, and delicate shrubs and potted plants stand unprotected while you wait to get around to doing something about it. Then the leaves are already black, and it's too late to do anything.

A jacket you pull over the shrub – 2-pack, 120 × 180 cm

Two jackets in beige nonwoven fabric go over shrubs or potted plants, 120 × 180 cm each. The zipper can be opened to water or check on the plant without lifting off the whole jacket, and the drawstring at the bottom edge is pulled tight around the trunk or the pot.

Features

  • 2 jackets in the package – enough for two shrubs or potted plants, 120 × 180 cm each.
  • Water without lifting off the jacket – the zipper opens to reach the plant.
  • Stays put around the trunk or pot – the drawstring at the bottom edge is pulled tight.
  • Shields from wind and cold – polypropylene nonwoven fabric goes as a layer over the whole plant.
  • Fits both shrubs and potted plants – the jacket goes over the whole plant whether it stands in soil or in a pot.

The lifestyle images are AI-generated illustrations.

14 days to change your mind – if you don't like it, you get your money back. Tracked delivery and secure checkout. 🦫
